The Prophet asked his companions which tree, never shedding its leaves, is like a Muslim; Ibn Umar shyly kept silent, and the answer was the date palm.
Allah welcomed the man who joined the Prophet's circle, those present were told to inform the absent, and the Prophet preached at intervals and bade people make religion easy.
Allah grants understanding of the religion to whom He wishes good, the Prophet being only a distributor, and the Prophet asked which tree resembles a Muslim: the date palm.
The Prophet embraced Ibn Abbas and prayed that Allah grant him knowledge of the Book.
Umar and an Ansari neighbour took turns attending the Prophet to share news of revelation; once alarming news sent Umar to the Prophet, who had not divorced his wives.
Allah takes away knowledge by the death of scholars, until people take ignorant leaders who give verdicts without knowledge, going astray and leading others astray.
The Prophet declared blood, property and honour mutually sacred like that day and month, told those present to inform the absent, and asked whether he had conveyed the message.
Ali kept a written sheet of rulings, the Prophet had the Mecca sermon written for a Yemeni, Abdullah bin Amr wrote hadith, and the ailing Prophet asked for paper.
Abu Huraira narrated much, citing verses against concealment and his constant company with the Prophet, never forgot after spreading his garment for him, and kept back one kind of knowledge.
Ibn Umar was too shy to name the date palm when the Prophet asked which tree is like a Muslim, and his father wished he had answered.
Of three men at the Prophet's mosque gathering, Allah took in the one who joined the circle, sheltered the shy one behind, and turned from the one who left.
Abu Huraira narrates more than emigrants busy trading or Ansar busy with property because he stayed with the Prophet, and after spreading his garment at his word forgot nothing.
Abu Huraira says he narrates much because he stayed with the Prophet while others traded or tended their properties, and after spreading his sheet he forgot nothing of that statement.
Convey the Prophet's teaching even one sentence; telling stories of the Children of Israel is no sin; whoever deliberately lies about the Prophet takes his place in the Fire.
Abu Huraira, who forgot many narrations, spread his sheet as the Prophet told him, wrapped himself in what the Prophet scooped into it, and never forgot again.
Asked which tree is like a Muslim, Ibn Umar thought of the date palm but kept silent before Abu Bakr and Umar, and his father wished he had spoken.
Ibn Mas'ud explained that he did not come out to preach every day because the Prophet preached to them at intervals so they would not be bored.
The Prophet sent young men who missed their families home to teach them, telling them to pray as they saw him pray, call the adhan, and let the eldest lead.
Knowledge will vanish with the death of scholars, leaving the ignorant to give misleading verdicts by opinion, and at Siffin Sahl bin Hunaif told people to distrust their own opinions.
A woman asked for a day of teaching for women; the Prophet taught them, then said a woman who loses three children, or even two, is screened from the Fire.
